newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Rand Leases posts half yr pre-tax loss.
newsitem.headline: Rand Leases posts half yr pre-tax loss.

text.p: Full name: Rand Leases Properties Ltd
* Latest results are compared with those for the 12 months to June 30 1996.

NOTE - The company said net income was affected by a lower royalty paymend from Rand Leases Gold Mining Co (RLM), the cancellation of royalties from rock sales which had reverted back to RLM and a downturn in industrial stand sales from Rand Leases Extension 10.

A revaluation of a portion of the company's propoerty had also resulted in a five fold increase in assessment rates due to the fact that the increase was backdated to July 1994. This amount was being disputed and was currently under review.
